title: A New Dwarf Planet Beyond Pluto? Meet 2026 ED138
description:
A new telescope may have found a sixth dwarf planet. The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has spotted 2026 ED138, a distant world beyond Pluto.
It's about 46 times farther from the Sun than Earth, and an estimated 600 to 1,500 km across. It still needs to be confirmed.
